pricing.formula: bonus^2 x base; total of enhancement + ability bonuses, max +10 (abilities need at least +1)

rollRules.abilityAndRollAgain: Roll one special ability (by grade, on the table for the item kind), then roll again on the main table; a second "special ability" result adds another ability.
rollRules.rollTwice: Roll twice more on the ability table. Reroll duplicates, incompatible abilities, and anything that would take the total past +10.
rollRules.abilityRestrictions: Keen: piercing or slashing. Vorpal: slashing. Disruption: bludgeoning. Throwing: melee only. Returning: thrown weapons only. Reroll if randomly generated for the wrong weapon.
rollRules.betterVersion: If two versions of the same armor/shield ability are rolled, keep the better one.
